status_detail: The four-case covered projection byte-matches Ghidra 12.0.4: the LE/BE x forceleft branch matrix (address.cc:138 branch key = space endianness, not forceleft), the unflagged LE ParamEntry ==0 wrapper route, the heritage.cc:1221 truncate SUBPIECE constant, and the characterizeAsParam resolver gating for extent-out queries. Overall remains UNTESTED because the BE-space ParamEntry wrapper, join-piece resolver windows, the space-mismatch base branch and find_entry's ungated scan are not exercised.

comparand.rust_crate_tree_hash_scheme: sha256 of rugra-fspec-endian-resolver-base-overlay-v1 plus base commit and sorted length-prefixed paths and contents

architecture.spaces: const=0, other=1, unique=2, ram=3 (little-endian), ram_be=4 (big-endian); byte addressed, wordsize 1
architecture.space_construction: FixtureTranslate/AddrSpace inserts ConstantSpace, OtherSpace, UniqueSpace and two IPTR_PROCESSOR AddrSpaces (ram LE index 3, ram_be BE index 4) with AddrSpace::hasphysical; the LE/BE pair is the decisive endianness control for Address::justifiedContain branch selection (address.cc:138)

compiler_spec.prototype_xml: no cspec decode; staged ParamEntry resources (case2: one unflagged LE exclusion 8B@0x100 min1; case4: two unflagged LE exclusion entries 4B@0x100 min1 and 8B@0x200 min1 in a ParamListStandard)
compiler_spec.calling_convention: hand-built ParamEntry/ParamListStandard via the staged loader (C++ direct field writes under the class->struct access hack, Rust pub builder setters); populateResolver/finalize_after_decode complete the case-4 model

analysis_options.api: Direct production Address::justifiedContain, ParamEntry::justifiedContain (alignment==0 path) and ParamListStandard::characterizeAsParam calls on both sides; no Action, Rule, PrintC or Funcdata pipeline
analysis_options.model_state: case1: raw Address pairs in ram/ram_be over 7 (base, esz, qoff, qsz) geometries x 4 (forceleft, endian) combinations; case2: one unflagged LE exclusion entry 8B@0x100; case3: heritage.cc:1221 call shape over 5 (addr, size, toff, tsz) geometries in both spaces; case4: ParamListStandard with two unflagged LE exclusion entries (4B@0x100, 8B@0x200), populateResolver
analysis_options.normalization: None. Raw int4 distances, truncate amounts and classification codes (no_containment=0, contains_unjustified=1, contains_justified=2, contained_by=3) are printed verbatim; the C++ side additionally exits non-zero if LE(false) != LE(true) != BE(true) branch consistency fails
analysis_options.random_seed: none; construction and queries are deterministic
analysis_options.error_injection: none; all queries stay on valid inputs

input_manifest.canonicalization: SHA-256 of UTF-8 json.dumps({architecture, compiler_spec, analysis_options, cases}, sort_keys=True, separators=(',',':'), ensure_ascii=False)

cases.setup: Address::justifiedContain over 7 geometries (exact, low sub-range, size-1 high byte, mid sub-range, size-1 low/high bytes of a 4B entry, equal-start-bigger violation) x the full (forceleft in {0,1}) x (space in {ram LE, ram_be BE}) matrix
cases.queries: 28 rows: jc base/esz/qoff/qsz fl be off
cases.expect: the branch key is base->isBigEndian() && !forceleft (address.cc:138): LE rows print the start distance op2.offset - offset for BOTH forceleft values (the FSPEC-JUSTIFIED-ENDIAN-0002 route), BE+forceleft=1 rows the start distance, only BE+forceleft=0 rows the end distance off1 - off2; the violation geometry returns -1 on every branch

cases.setup: ParamEntry::justifiedContain alignment==0 path over an UNFLAGGED little-endian exclusion entry (8B@0x100, minsize 1)
cases.queries: exact, low sub-range, unjustified sub-range, flush-high sub-range, size-1 sub-range, equal-start-bigger, low overlap inside, high poke
cases.expect: the wrapper forwards forceleft=(flags & force_left_justify)=0 and the entry space endianness drives the address.cc:138 branch: LE returns the start distance, so the low sub-range is justified (off=0, the ==0 determination fixed by ENDIAN-0002) and the flush-high sub-range is 6, not 0

cases.setup: the heritage.cc:1221 call shape addr.justifiedContain(size, truncAddr, vData.size, false) over 5 geometries (heritage range with contained parameter, plus one poke-out violation), in both the LE and BE space
cases.queries: 10 rows: tr spc addr size toff tsz amt
cases.expect: LE rows print the start distance truncAddr - addr (the SUBPIECE constant src/heritage.rs guard_call_overlapping_input now produces); BE rows the end distance (addr+size-1) - (truncAddr+vData.size-1); the violation returns -1 in both spaces

cases.setup: ParamListStandard with two unflagged LE exclusion entries (4B@0x100, 8B@0x200), populateResolver/finalize_after_decode
cases.queries: 12 rows: start between extents (overlap nothing / cover E2), start above every extent, start below E1 covering it, exact E2, unjustified inside E2, equal-start poke, start below E2 covering exactly, start between above E1, start below everything, start below covering both, start inside E2 poking high
cases.expect: fspec.cc:682-719 resolver gating: phase 1 visits only entries whose registered extent contains the query start; the containedBy scan runs only when some registered extent starts above the query start (cc:708 iterpair.first != resolver->end()) and covers entries whose registered start falls in (offset, offset+size-1]; a query start above every extent skips the containedBy scan entirely -> no_containment

observation_schema.format: 63 fixed-order UTF-8 lines with final newline: one envelope, four case headers, then 28 jc rows (7 geometries x 4 forceleft/endian combinations), 8 pe rows, 10 tr rows (5 geometries x 2 spaces) and 12 ch rows
observation_schema.branches: jc rows pin the address.cc:138 branch key: (be=0,fl=0/1) and (be=1,fl=1) print the start distance op2.offset - offset; only (be=1,fl=0) prints the end distance off1 - off2; the C++ harness verifies LE(false)==LE(true)==BE(true) internally and exits non-zero on violation
observation_schema.wrapper: pe rows print the raw alignment==0 wrapper distance over an unflagged LE entry (start distance; ==0 iff the query starts at the entry base)
observation_schema.truncate: tr rows print the heritage.cc:1221 SUBPIECE constant; LE rows count from the range start, BE rows from the range end
observation_schema.classification: ch rows print the numeric characterizeAsParam code (no_containment=0, contains_unjustified=1, contains_justified=2, contained_by=3); extent-out queries pin the resolver gate (phase-2 containedBy scan skipped entirely when no registered extent starts above the query start)

decisive_semantics.references_and_outputs: Address::justifiedContain returns int4 by value (-1 or the endian-aware distance); ParamEntry::justifiedContain forwards forceleft=(flags & force_left_justify) with the entry space endianness; characterizeAsParam consumes the justifiedContain sign (==0 justified, >0 unjustified) and the exclusion containedBy before no_containment
decisive_semantics.loop_bounds_traversal_order: characterizeAsParam phase 1 walks the per-space resolver interval containing loc.getOffset() (resolverMap[space->getIndex()], populateResolver fspec.cc:1191-1216 registers entry extents and join piece extents), phase 2 only when iterpair.first != resolver->end() (cc:708) scans entries starting inside (loc.getOffset(), loc.getOffset()+size-1] via find_end
decisive_semantics.counters_and_accumulators: resContains/resContainedBy are two booleans accumulated during phase 1 only, never reset; no numeric counters
decisive_semantics.sort_and_comparison_keys: containment decision keys are op2.offset < offset and off2 > off1 (uintb, independent); the branch key is base->isBigEndian() && !forceleft; the resolver gate key is the existence of a registered extent start above the query start (the rangemap refinement splits at every registered start, so an interval exists above the query interval iff a higher start exists); classification tie order is justified before unjustified before contained_by before no_containment (fspec.cc:697-714 return ladder)
